verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships official multi-platform SDKs (Swift, Kotlin, C++ core with six bindings) with documented APIs for LLM, STT, TTS, VAD, tool-calling, structured output, and an OpenAI-compatible cloud endpoint, giving AI-native developers real official surfaces to build against. However community reports show real friction (segfaults, incomplete Homebrew installs, tool-calling grounding failures) and there's no discoverable OpenAPI spec, and no independent corroboration that the SDKs are robust in production. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of SDK reliability, a published OpenAPI/schema spec, and resolution of the reported crashes/tool-calling grounding bugs.
